verdict.rationale: Devin offers some event- and time-driven automation: cron-based recurring and one-time schedules via Devin MCP, Devin Review Auto-Fix that responds automatically to code review comments and CI failures, Slack/Teams tagging that starts sessions, and an API for building workflow automations. There is no documented general rule engine where users define their own event→action triggers. Missing for 10: user-configurable event-based rule definitions, an arbitrary event/webhook trigger catalog, and independent corroboration that the automations work.
